intro: Explore ways to support local races, connect with the community, and be part of memorable race-day experiences. Select an event below to see its current opportunities.

events.name: The Merriest Night
events.summary: A festive evening of running, holiday activities, and community celebration.

opportunities.title: Race Sponsors
opportunities.description: Support the event and help us create a memorable experience for runners, walkers, and families. Contact us to discuss sponsorship possibilities and recognition options.
opportunities.subject: The Merriest Night — Race Sponsorship Inquiry

opportunities.title: Corporate Sponsor Teams
opportunities.description: Interested in participating as a company or organization? Ask about getting your employees involved together and potential corporate sponsorship opportunities.
opportunities.subject: The Merriest Night — Corporate Team Inquiry

opportunities.title: Craft Vendors
opportunities.description: We are looking for craft vendors and makers interested in being part of our festive North Pole Main Street. Reach out with information about your business and what you would like to offer.
opportunities.subject: The Merriest Night — Craft Vendor Inquiry

opportunities.title: Food & Beverage Vendors
opportunities.description: Interested in bringing food or beverages to the event? Contact us to discuss potential vendor opportunities and event requirements.
opportunities.subject: The Merriest Night — Food Vendor Inquiry

opportunities.title: Community Partners & Volunteers
opportunities.description: Local groups, organizations, and individuals who would like to contribute to the holiday atmosphere or help on event day are welcome to inquire.
opportunities.subject: The Merriest Night — Community Partner or Volunteer Inquiry
